verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an official MCP server on its developer portal (probe-3). It also publishes a supported Claude connector via MCP and a Gemini CLI pairing with Docusign MCP. The documented tools let agents retrieve agreement context and metadata, query status and key dates, and trigger IAM workflow actions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and operate reliably through the MCP server.
